title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Georgia
part_text: 11. Stresses that participation in elections is a fundamental constitutional right of every Georgian citizen and has to be made possible regardless of one’s place of residence; affirms thatthe municipal elections of 4 October 2025 were conducted within the established legal and constitutional framework, while the decision of certain opposition parties to boycott the elections was an extreme political choice; emphasises that amendments to Georgia’s Electoral Code were adopted through parliamentary procedures with the aim of improving electoral administration and legal clarity;
